issues.on_page: Transportation 220,163 (General and administrative; Depreciation Fund p12, whose only budget line is Capital outlay 403,629)
issues.issue: This is probably bus purchases, which would make it capital outlay. Student transportation follows the printed label, so it is defensible. It already carries a review note; the same applies to detail[45].
The capital outlay rule (2026-10-26) relabels this as 'Capital Outlay: <function>' with the printed text kept in printed_label. This is not applied.
